description: This Java class handles bulk updates to loan officers within the loan account module. It processes commands to reassign multiple loans to a different officer using the LoanWritePlatformService.

classes.name: BulkUpdateLoanOfficerCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles bulk reassignment of loans to different officers, annotated as a Spring Service and command handler for the BULKREASSIGN action.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes incoming JSON commands to reassign loans in bulk by invoking the LoanWritePlatformService.
